msg: Cloning into a clean Vercel Sandbox (Ubuntu, Python 3.14, Node 24)
Nemotron Nano reads the README and extracts the install path

rootCause: The package's binary is named `readme` (not `readme-md-generator`), but `npx readme-md-generator` fails to resolve and execute this binary on Node 24 due to an npx binary resolution issue. The error `sh: 1: readme: not found` confirms npx attempts to run `readme` but cannot locate it in the temporary PATH.
patch:
--- README.md
+++ README.md
@@ -47,19 +47,19 @@ Example of `package.json` with good meta data:
 
 ## 🚀 Usage
 
 Make sure you have [npx](https://www.npmjs.com/package/npx) installed (`npx` is shipped by default since npm `5.2.0`)
 
 Just run the following command at the root of your project and answer questions:
 
 ```sh
-npx readme-md-generator
+npx -p readme-md-generator readme
 ```
 
 Or use default values for all questions (`-y`):
 
 ```sh
-npx readme-md-generator -y
+npx -p readme-md-generator readme -y
 ```
 
 Use your own `ejs` README template (`-p`):
 
 ```sh
-npx readme-md-generator -p path/to/my/own/template.md
+npx -p readme-md-generator readme -p path/to/my/own/template.md
 ```

log:
+ set -eo pipefail
+ export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
+ DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
+ set -e
+ cd /tmp
+ rm -rf test-readme-generator

+ cd test-readme-generator
+ git init -q
+ git config user.email test@example.com
+ git config user.name 'Test User'
+ cat
+ npx -p readme-md-generator readme --version
npm warn exec The following package was not found and will be installed: readme-md-generator@1.0.0
1.0.0
